test_sequence_scorer: test the SequenceScorer class by running unit tests with dummy dictionaries and expected beam probabilities
run_sequence_scorer_tests: run the TestSequenceScorer unittest suite to validate fairseq sequence scoring against expected token probabilities
assert_hypo_tokens: assert hypothesis tokens match expected token sequences using the assertHypoTokens helper method
assert_hypo_score: assert hypothesis positional scores match expected probabilities using the assertHypoScore helper method
assert_tensor_equal: assert two PyTorch tensors are equal in size and content using the assertTensorEqual helper method
